verdict.rationale: Kling documents its own RESTful API with JWT authentication built from AccessKey and SecretKey, plus global and China endpoints. That supports non-interactive, key-based programmatic use suited to headless or CI runs. Its marketing also claims an MCP/CLI path for agents and says it can 'automate the entire production process'. However, the CLI is only a one-line marketing mention, and nothing shows CI-specific usage. Missing for 10: CLI documentation (install, commands, flags), CI/pipeline integration examples or guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of headless runs.
